curatedMovie.curiosityHook: When an ignored kid suddenly vanishes from sight for real, how will he navigate middle school and the girl he likes?
curatedMovie.description: Shy and unpopular thirteen-year-old Michele spends his days pining after his classmate Stella. Everything shifts after a Halloween costume party when he wakes up to discover he has mysteriously become invisible.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Lighthearted and exciting family sci-fi fantasy with a steady pace and easygoing stakes.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: This family fantasy gives a familiar school crush and a strange discovery an imaginative, youthful science-fiction frame.
